text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good job, Bright! You're running at just
the right pace for 3,200
meters! Just try
to remember this for the race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Right! One more lap should help me
remember!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! One more lap it is!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Surveilling the enemy, are we? They
certainly look like they're ready
for a fight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She may not look it, but Bright is
incredibly strong-willed.
Not to mention
talented.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That being said, so is Special Week. All
her hard work is bound to
pay off on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Speaking of Spe, where the heck is she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She and Trainer should be having a
meeting regarding the spring
Tenno Sho
about now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So I need to think about pace and strategy?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, you should pay attention to
your own stamina levels, but
you should
also be aware of how you can manipulate
those of your
rivals.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, you should pay attention to
your own stamina levels, but
you should
also be aware of how you can manipulate
those of your
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That sounds... really hard.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I'll do it if it'll help me win! The bigger
the race, the bigger the
impression a good
showing can make, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
McQueen? Do you need Trainer for
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is less about what I need and more
about what you two might
need from me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I understand that your meeting concerns
your upcoming race, so I
thought I might
be of service.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
True. You won the spring Tenno Sho not
just once, but twice. We'd
love your help.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
True. You won the spring Tenno Sho not
just once, but twice. We'd
love your help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All right, then I shall join you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Knockity, knock-knock! I'm coming in!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're talking strategy, right? Anything I
can do to help? Huh?
What's McQueen
doing here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-excuse m—wait, what? What are
McQueen and Ticket doing here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like I didn't need to come here
after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! It's a lot more crowded in here
all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... race developments, holding a good
position... I feel like I've
studied enough to
fill a library!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But you know, after getting all that
advice, I feel like I've got this in
the bag!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! Just do your best!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We'll be cheering you on the day of, so
bring home the gold!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, the whole Team Sirius
crew is in my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember being told I was a pillar from
which our teammates reach
for their
dreams... But it seems like I'm not the only
pillar on the team.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, before I forget, Trainer! I have
something to give you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Here! I filled out that survey they gave us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Surely you remember the survey Tazuna
told us to fill out...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, that survey...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Averting their dumbfounded gazes out of
embarrassment, I look down
at the survey.
Suddenly, my eyes focus in on one answer
in particular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Which race means the most to you?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A giant "THE JAPANESE DERBY!" fills up
the entire answer space,
which makes
sense for Winning Ticket. But squeezed
into the corner,
in much smaller writing is...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You got a race other than the Derby on
your mind? What, did ya eat
something
funny?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's nothing like that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The Derby will always be first place in my
heart, but this survey's for
the feature on
Team Sirius, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
As I was thinking of all my memories with
the team, my head went
DA-DIIING! Like a
lightbulb went off!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The reason I knew about Team Sirius in the
first place was because of
McQueen's first
spring Tenno Sho win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, to be fair, I didn't know a lot about
the team's history at first. I
just thought it
was a good race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But when I found out about everything
McQueen went through and
how the
future of the team depended on that
race...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAH! I'm so glad I saw such a
passionate race with my own
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was the same way! That race convinced
me to join the team!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was so surprised to find out McQueen
was the only member... But
we've gained
more and more racers ever since!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The spring Tenno Sho means a lot to me
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That race taught me just how much work
goes into winning... And just
how much
happiness a win can bring.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...As for me, the spring Tenno Sho is
another prize to chase.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't participate the first time due to
an injury, and then my
second chance
ended with victory just out of my reach...
To this day, I
still hunger for that win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the reasons differ, the spring
Tenno Sho holds a special place
in all their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying that the same goes
for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That race was Mejiro McQueen's main goal
and my first G1 victory as
a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It also marks the first time I was able to
help an Umamusume achieve
her dreams.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That race holds a lot of memories for me
too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That race holds a lot of memories for me
too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So it wasn't just me... It's an irreplaceable
race for all of us...
WAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... If I win the spring Tenno
Sho, will you be happy?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Of course. You've been working so hard,
I'd love to see it all pay off
for you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I didn't mean as a goal...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It just seems like this race holds a special
place in all of your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I want to make it a special memory for
me too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You see, Team Sirius is like a home away
from home for me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You've all done so much to help me, just
like a real family would.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to win the spring Tenno
Sho—as a member of Team
Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As a member of Team Sirius, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, then I'll hold you to that
promise. I look forward to seeing
the
shield that marked our team's rebirth.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I want to see that shield again.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Me too, me too! So Spe... please win this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You sure 'bout this, Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, perhaps you would like to say a
few words of encouragement
as well?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I promise I'll win the spring
Tenno Sho, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week gazes at me with a strong,
almost gallant gaze. Those
eyes of hers
haven't changed since she first came here
from
Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her now, I can confidently say
that she'll someday be the
best racer in
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Okay!
